competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: "Real dealers tested us too—and chose Chrome extension simplicity over app bloat. See why Ventrix auto-fill beats multi-platform complexity." (Emphasize speed-to-value vs. Shiftly's enterprise pricing and CARVID's feature overload.)

competitor_signals.signal: Updated Facebook compliance guide (May 28, 2026) claiming 'As of May 2026, Facebook has increased enforcement strictness. Dealers now receive: Instant 30-day bans for first spam violation.' Positioned CARVID's ban protection as differentiator; claims 73+ dealerships with zero bans.
competitor_signals.what_it_means: CARVID is weaponizing Facebook's stricter enforcement (a market headwind) to justify complexity and fear-sell compliance. This signals dealers are concerned about bans.
competitor_signals.ventrix_counter_angle: "Facebook Marketplace bans are overblown—here's what ACTUALLY triggers them (and how Ventrix avoids all of it with human-like posting out of the box)." Educate, don't fear-sell.
